messages.content: Southwest changed Monday’s WN 2418 to an evening flight that lands after 9:00 p.m. That will not work before the 8:00 a.m. museum start Tuesday. What can they move me to without changing Thursday’s Delta flight or the Cheshire reservation?

Because Southwest made a substantial schedule change, you can move the affected outbound to another Southwest flight on October 12 without a fare difference, or cancel that segment for a refund. The usable nonstop options are 7:05-8:00 a.m. and 10:25-11:20 a.m. Both include your carry-on and checked supply case. Your Delta return and hotel are separate reservations, so neither needs to be touched.
Is the 10:25 still free even though it costs more than my original flight? And compare it with the afternoon flight on the other carrier.

Yes. Southwest is waiving the difference for either replacement. The 10:25 a.m. flight reaches St. Louis at 11:20 a.m. The Delta alternative leaves ATL at 1:40 p.m. and arrives at 2:28 p.m.; it is $189 plus $35 for the checked supply case. Canceling the disrupted Southwest segment would return $214, making Delta’s net additional cost $10.
How much preparation time would each leave after getting to the Cheshire?

Allowing for baggage claim and the ride to Forest Park, the 7:05 flight should put you at the hotel around 9:00-9:30 a.m., the 10:25 around 12:20-12:50 p.m., and Delta around 3:30-4:00 p.m. The hotel can hold both bags before check-in under the existing note.
For this trip, use the morning rather than a later departure. I need the extra setup time, and this does not change how I want return flights handled. Is there any downside to taking the 7:05?

The main downside is the early airport start: with the checked case, plan to reach ATL by about 5:20 a.m. Otherwise it is the strongest option. It is nonstop, costs nothing to rebook, preserves the included baggage, and gives you most of Monday in St. Louis.
Make that change only. Keep Thursday’s Delta 4:15 p.m. return and all three hotel nights exactly as booked.

Southwest has rebooked only the Monday outbound under confirmation L8Q2RM: October 12, ATL 7:05 a.m. to STL 8:00 a.m. There is no fare difference, and the carry-on and checked supply case remain included. Delta DL 1284 on Thursday at 4:15 p.m., confirmation H6T9VK, is unchanged. The Cheshire reservation for October 12-15 under CHS-804621, including the early-arrival and Thursday storage notes, is also unchanged.
